description: Baseline Electron knowledge base with minimal harness

features.name: Window Launch
features.description: Electron app opens a BrowserWindow with correct dimensions and preload script
features.evidence: Smoke test (npm run smoke) launches real app: window visible at 1200x800, preload bridge window.knowledgeBase reachable, no renderer console errors.

features.name: Document List Panel
features.description: Left sidebar shows imported documents with empty state message
features.evidence: Smoke test asserts "No documents imported yet" empty state, then lists 3 imported docs with status badge/size/chunk count; clicking an item opens it.

features.name: Question Panel
features.description: Bottom input bar accepts questions and submits via IPC
features.evidence: Smoke test types into the question input and submits the form; answer arrives via qa:ask IPC and renders with citations. Button disables while a question is in flight.

features.name: Data Directory
features.description: PersistenceService creates and manages userData/knowledge-base-data directory
features.evidence: PersistenceService creates userData/knowledge-base-data (documents/, content/, chunks/, index/index-meta.json); smoke test checks index-meta exists. Writes are atomic (tmp+rename) and paths cannot escape the dir (unit tested).

features.name: Document Import
features.description: Import .txt/.md via native file dialog or drag-and-drop; rejects other types and files >10 MB; auto-indexes on import
features.evidence: Unit tests cover type/size validation and same-name files; smoke test imports 3 sample docs via IPC and they reach status "indexed".

features.name: Document Viewer
features.description: Show full document text and its chunks with metadata
features.evidence: Smoke test opens meeting-summary and asserts its text renders in the Content tab; Chunks tab lists chunks with char/word counts.

features.name: Text Indexing
features.description: Paragraph-aware ~500-char chunking; index a single document or all unindexed documents
features.evidence: Unit tests: chunks stay <=500 chars incl. oversized paragraphs; single-doc indexing registers in index and sets status "indexed"; index-all skips already-indexed docs.

features.name: Grounded Q&A
features.description: Answers quote matching sentences/list items from indexed chunks with citations; confidence 0.85 with citations, 0.30 without
features.evidence: Unit test asserts every quoted line appears verbatim in a cited chunk; no-match and empty-library cases return 0.30 with no citations.

features.name: Citation Navigation
features.description: Clicking a citation opens the source document and highlights the cited chunk
features.evidence: Smoke test clicks the first citation and asserts a highlighted chunk is shown.

features.name: Document Delete
features.description: Delete removes metadata, content, original copy, chunks and index entry
features.evidence: Unit test + smoke test: after delete, status shows 2 loaded / 2 indexed and no chunks remain for the deleted doc.

features.name: Status Bar
features.description: Shows index status (idle/indexing/ready/error), document and indexed counts, last activity
features.evidence: app:status IPC now registered and returns AppStatus; smoke test verifies {documentsLoaded:3, documentsIndexed:3, indexStatus:"ready"}.

features.name: Q&A History
features.description: Q&A history persists across sessions and is browsable in the UI
features.evidence: Unit test reads history from a fresh QaService instance; UI restores the last answer on launch and lists previous questions.
